# mapbox tilesets

Tiles API

Raster and vector tiles, by tileset id.

3 commands. A description too long for its table cell is shortened here; `mapbox --schema <command>` has the whole of every one, as JSON. Placeholders in the examples are written in `UPPER_CASE` and have to be replaced.

## Commands

### mapbox tilesets get-mvt

Get a vector tile

Retrieve a single vector tile from one or more Mapbox-hosted tilesets.

This endpoint is compatible with tiling schemes used by mapping software that expects a URL with placeholders for zoom level (`{zoom}`), tile column (`{x}`), and tile row (`{y}`).

Supports up to 15 comma-separated tileset IDs for compositing. When multiple tilesets are specified, their layers are merged into a single tile response.

**Style-optimized tiles**: Include the optional `style` query parameter to request a style-optimized tile. Style-optimized tiles remove data that would be invisible given the style's zoom-level filters and layer visibility, resulting in smaller tile payloads.

`GET https://api.mapbox.com/v4/{tileset_id}/{zoom}/{x}/{y}.{format}`

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tileset-id` | `TILESET_ID` | yes | string |  | Tileset ID(s) in the format `username. Sent in the request path. |
| `zoom` | `ZOOM` | yes | integer |  | Zoom level per the [Slippy Map Tilenames](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Slippy_map_tilenames) specification. Valid range is 0–30, though tile availability depends on the tileset's configured zoom range. Sent in the request path. |
| `x` | `X` | yes | integer |  | Tile column (x coordinate) per the Slippy Map Tilenames specification. Sent in the request path. |
| `y` | `Y` | yes | integer |  | Tile row (y coordinate) per the Slippy Map Tilenames specification. Sent in the request path. |
| `format` | `FORMAT` | yes | string | `mvt`, `vector.pbf` | Vector tile format. Both formats contain identical data encoded as a [Mapbox Vector Tile](https://docs.mapbox.com/data/tilesets/guides/vector-tiles-standards/). Sent in the request path. |
| `style` | `--style STYLE` | no | string |  | Style ID and timestamp used to request a style-optimized tile, in the format `<style_id>@<timestamp>` (e.g., `mapbox://styles/mapbox/streets-v12@00`). Sent in the request query. |

```sh
mapbox tilesets get-mvt TILESET_ID 0 0 0 mvt
```

### mapbox tilesets get-tile

Get raster tile with standard resolution

Retrieve a raster tile at standard resolution (256x256 pixels)

This endpoint is compatible with tiling schemes used by mapping software that expects a URL with placeholders for zoom level (`{z}`), tile column (`{x}`), and tile row (`{y}`).

`GET https://api.mapbox.com/v4/{tilesets}/{z}/{x}/{y}.{format}{quality}`

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tilesets` | `TILESETS` | yes | string |  | Tileset ID(s) in the format `username. Sent in the request path. |
| `z` | `Z` | yes | integer |  | Zoom level (0-22). Sent in the request path. |
| `x` | `X` | yes | integer |  | Tile column (x coordinate). Sent in the request path. |
| `y` | `Y` | yes | integer |  | Tile row (y coordinate). Sent in the request path. |
| `format` | `FORMAT` | yes | string | `png`, `pngraw`, `jpg`, `jpeg`, `webp` | Image format for the tile. Sent in the request path. |
| `quality` | `QUALITY` | yes | string |  | Compression quality parameter appended to format (e. Sent in the request path. Pass an empty string to leave it out of the URL. |

```sh
mapbox tilesets get-tile TILESETS 0 0 0 png QUALITY
```

### mapbox tilesets query

Tilequery

Query one or more tilesets at a coordinate to return nearby features.

`GET https://api.mapbox.com/v4/{tilesets}/tilequery/{lon},{lat}.json`

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tilesets` | `TILESETS` | yes | string |  | Comma-separated tileset ids in the form `{owner}.{tileset}`. Sent in the request path. |
| `lon` | `LON` | yes | number |  | Longitude in degrees (range -180 to 180). Sent in the request path. |
| `lat` | `LAT` | yes | number |  | Latitude in degrees (range -85.0511 to 85.0511). Sent in the request path. |
| `bands` | `--bands BANDS` | no | string |  | Comma-separated list of rasterarray band names to include. Sent in the request query. |
| `dedupe` | `--dedupe` | no | boolean |  | Deduplicate features by layer and geometry (vector only). Sent in the request query. |
| `geometry` | `--geometry GEOMETRY` | no | string | `polygon`, `linestring`, `point` | Limit results to features of this geometry type. Sent in the request query. |
| `language` | `--language LANGUAGE` | no | string |  | BCP-47 language code (vector only). Comma-separated list is validated. Sent in the request query. |
| `layers` | `--layers LAYERS` | no | string |  | Comma-separated list of layer names to include. Required for rasterarray queries to return data; if omitted, rasterarray responses are empty. Sent in the request query. |
| `limit` | `--limit LIMIT` | no | integer |  | Max number of vector features to return (1-50). Ignored for rasterarray tilesets. Sent in the request query. |
| `radius` | `--radius RADIUS` | no | number |  | Search radius in meters. Must be a positive number. Sent in the request query. |
| `worldview` | `--worldview WORLDVIEW` | no | string |  | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 worldview (vector only). Comma-separated list accepted. Sent in the request query. |

```sh
mapbox tilesets query TILESETS 0 0
```
